It was theorized by Doctor Gorman Vandrayk centuries ago, but never realized.''"<br />"''As I recall, a Vandrayk Generator runs on a form of energy that doesn't exist.|Tharan Cedrax and the [[Barsen'thor]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Vandrayk Generator''' was a theorized machine first proposed by the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Gorman Vandrayk]] during the [[Old Sith Wars]]. The Generator was supposed to run on a form of energy which did not exist at the time. Hundreds of years later, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Exo-technology|exo-technologist]] [[Tharan Cedrax]] built a working prototype of the Vandrayk Generator for the [[Lumenatus Club]] annual scientific symposium. Knowing that his invention would only work for a minute, after which its invaluable core would burn out, Cedrax dismantled his creation, instead using the generator's core to increase the [[Sentience/Legends|sentience]] of his [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] partner [[Holiday (hologram)|Holiday]].
